title: community-label workflow: filter bot and internal-author PRs in the job-level if, not in shell, so they skip before runner allocation
answers: Why do bot PRs or maintainer PRs still start a job on the community labeling workflow?
How do I exclude a new author type or association from the community-label workflow?
Where is the check that decides whether a PR gets the Databricks/external community label?
Why did the labeling job use a runner even though it exited right away for internal PRs?
body:
Path: .github/workflows/community-label.yml:label-community is the pull_request-triggered job that applies the community label to external PRs; the job-level `if:` decides whether the job starts at all, and the run script handles the remaining API-dependent checks (profile company/email lookup via `gh api users/...`) before labeling.
Rule: Keep cheap eligibility checks that only need event payload fields (`github.repository`, `github.event.pull_request.user.type`, `github.event.pull_request.author_association`) in the job-level `if:` so ineligible PRs are skipped before a runner is provisioned; do not duplicate them as early-exit shell guards in `run:`. Checks that need an API call stay in the script.
Symptom: bot and internal (MEMBER/COLLABORATOR/OWNER) PRs were given a runner and ran the script, only to exit 0 after a shell guard, consuming CI capacity for no labeling work.
Constraints: Only applies to fields present in the event payload; anything requiring a `gh api` lookup cannot move into `if:`. Association exclusion is written as `!contains(fromJSON('[...]'), github.event.pull_request.author_association)`, so new excluded roles go in that list. Not applicable to the API-dependent affiliation check or the labeling step itself.
applies: Edits to .github/workflows/community-label.yml or similar pull_request-triggered workflows that gate on author type or association.
says: Bot and maintainer pull requests still start the community label job; how do I exclude them?
Community label runs for internal team PRs and wastes CI time; where is the author check?
Add a new author role to skip community labeling for pull requests.
search: community-label workflow: author type and association checks belong in the job-level if so ineligible pull requests skip before a runner starts. Association exclusions go in the fromJSON list in the if expression. Checks needing an API lookup stay in the script. Applies only to fields present in the event payload.
